name: 4d-blog-engine
description: 4D Blog Engine — operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. v0.5.3 pushes via the GitHub MCP API instead of bash git: no more 'Cmd+Q GitHub Desktop' warnings, no working-tree validation, no lockfile races, no expectation that the writer has or uses a git client. The plugin handles the push end-to-end via mcp__github__push_file (two API calls — hero first, then post — to keep references valid). Byte-identical republishes silently bump dateModified to today so the site rebuild fires. The writer sees a one-line confirmation and a success message; no git words, no GitHub Desktop, no branch picking. v0.5.2 introduced the local drafts/ convention: Phase 4 sign-off copies the signed post to <blog-project-dir>/drafts/<slug>.md as a clean writer-facing handoff; /publish reads from there. The piece directory at Posts/<slug>/ remains the forensic archive. v0.5.0 rewrote /publish end-to-end with vendored smart_quotes.py, hardened the earned-secret stall with deterministic checks, and reoriented hero-image proposals to story-grounded options first. v0.4.0 added /blog-voice (multi-voice supported) and unhardcoded all preset-voice references. v0.3.x stripped backend infrastructure out of the writer-facing setup. v0.2.0 added the lifecycle commands. Pipeline: takes a base document and an angle question; runs a 30-day discourse sweep across reddit, X, Hacker News, Substack, Facebook, Quora, podcasts, and academic sources; layers a /council:deliberate synthesis pass; builds a verified bibliography with AI-generated abstracts; drafts the blog post in the writer's voice using the research-pipeline content-writer; runs a two-tier anti-AI-slop pass (deterministic linter + LLM structural review with a second-pass audit); and ships through a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate scoring against a 100-point rubric. On a clean gate, produces a publication-ready blog post, a long-form LinkedIn article (full mirror, blog stays canonical), and a short hook-led LinkedIn teaser with a 3-axis scorecard. Trigger phrases: 'write a blog post from this document', 'derive a blog from this whitepaper', '/4d-blog-engine', 'set up the blog plugin', 'publish this post', 'release-owner gate'. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's 'Beyond the Prompt' whitepaper.
